Hero Database — Bear Hunt & PvP All 62

A database of all 62 Whiteout Survival heroes by generation, class, rarity and role (rally leader / joiner / exclusive gear / growth). See rally-leader skill, joiner skill, exclusive gear, plus skill loadout by rarity and which troop they buff. Useful for Bear Hunt and PvP team planning alike.

About this tool

Full explanation & FAQ

What this tool tells you

Browse all 65 Whiteout Survival heroes filtered by generation, troop type, rarity and role, with the expedition skills and exclusive-gear effects that matter in Bear Hunt and PvP. Badges show whether a hero's exclusive gear is for rallies or defense, so you can check before investing.

How it works

Built on the hero master data shared with the Bear Hunt simulator (normalised from the official wiki, official timeline and strategy sites), it separates exploration skills from expedition skills. Because joiners only contribute the leftmost hero's first expedition skill, the 'rally leader' and 'joiner' role tags follow that rule.

How to use it

Use the filters at the top (generation, troop type, rarity, exclusive gear, role) to narrow the list; each card shows the hero's expedition skills and gear effects. Star a hero to keep it in your favourites. When building a Bear Hunt team, test leader candidates in the simulator and joiner candidates in the Left-Hero Checker.

About skills: skills split into Exploration (heroes only) and Expedition (with troops); counts depend on rarity (Mythic 3+3 / Epic 3+2 / Rare 2+2). Full Exploration + Expedition skill summaries are now live for all 65 heroes — every hero from the Standard pool through Generation 16. Summaries are written in our own words from strategy wikis (not copied verbatim). The Rally / Defense badge on each card shows when their exclusive gear triggers.

How to read this database

Each card summarizes a hero's class, generation, rarity and role, plus the skill data we hold. Bear Hunt and PvP results shift with "who leads the rally (left)", "which heroes join" and "which troop type you buff", so this lets you compare those at a glance.

Class (Infantry / Lancer / Marksman) and what they buff

Heroes split into Infantry (20), Lancer (21) and Marksman (21). Each hero buffs its own troop type and brings same-class escorts in Exploration. Bear Hunt leans on marksman damage, but zeroing the infantry/lancer front line is penalized, so ratio balance matters (compare in the Troop Ratio Simulator).

Rarity and skill loadout

Rarity rises Rare < Epic < Mythic, and rarity sets how many skills a hero has:

RarityExplorationExpeditionCount in this data
Mythic (SSR)3349
Epic (SR)329
Rare (R)224

Exploration vs Expedition skills (important)

Hero skills come in two kinds:

  • Exploration skills — active when only heroes fight (Exploration, Arena).
  • Expedition skills — active when heroes go out with troops (PvP, beast/bear hunts, rallies, gathering). These are what matter in Bear Hunt and PvP.

In a rally, the joining side only contributes its lead hero's 1st expedition skill, while the rally leader benefits from the expedition skills of all their heroes. Most "added a strong hero but it didn't help" cases trace to the left-hero (rally leader) choice — check it in the Left-Hero Checker.

What the role tags mean

  • Rally Leader — strong when placed first (left) to lead a rally.
  • Joiner — has an effective 1st expedition skill for joining rallies.
  • Exclusive Gear — provides a rally buff via exclusive gear.
  • Growth — a subclass whose expedition skills partly feed city growth (research, healing, etc.).

Telling "Rally" from "Defense" exclusive gear

The buff from a hero's exclusive gear (Widget) splits into two kinds by trigger condition. We show a colored badge at the top of each card and let you filter with the "Gear" filter above, so you can tell attack (rally) from defense (garrison) heroes at a glance.

  • Rally (orange): the gear buff triggers on rallies (attack side) — rally attack / lethality / HP for the whole rally squad. Shines on offense in Bear Hunt and PvP (e.g. Jeronimo, Natalia, Mia, Alonso, Greg, Reina).
  • Defense (blue): the gear buff triggers on defense / garrison (defending side) — defender/garrison attack, defense, lethality or HP. Shines on defense of castles and fortresses (e.g. Logan, Flint, Philly, Bradley, Seigel, Aisling).

The same hero can belong in an attacking rally or a defending garrison depending on this gear. Check the badge before deciding where to invest. The rally/defense classification draws on in-game wording and strategy community sources (e.g. whiteoutsurvival.wiki).

Bear Hunt vs PvP usage

The same hero values different skills in Bear Hunt (rally damage) versus PvP. Bear Hunt favors expedition skills that raise damage dealt, attack and lethality; PvP also cares about damage reduction, enemy debuffs and front-line durability. This database starts with the expedition skills organized through Bear Hunt testing and will add PvP-oriented notes over time. For build priority see growing as F2P and the light-spender ranking.

FAQ

Why aren't all skills listed?
To avoid posting wrong numbers, we add skills we can verify from official info. The current focus is the expedition skills and exclusive gear organized through Bear Hunt testing; exploration skills and PvP-only effects are being expanded.
How current is the data?
All 65 heroes, organized from official info and measurement as of June 2026.
Can I use it for PvP teams?
Yes. Filtering by class and role helps you check rally-leader candidates and same-class combos.
